text:
ana (People Ops): Heads-up: Lee's onboarding package shows as delivered to the wrong campus reception. Lees Day 1 is tomorrow at 10am. Can someone help confirm pickup?

lee (new hire): Oh no  I didn't get a notice. Tracking says "delivered to Building C reception" but my office is near Building A. I can swing by if it's held.

marco (Facilities): Looking at the log  drop recorded 17:03, signed "Lobby Team". Photo attached in the portal looks like our standard crate with Redwood tape.

it-oncall: If hardware delayed, we can provide a temporary cloud workstation + SSO access so Lee can join Day 1. Also will send step-by-step for registering software MFA until the YubiKey arrives.

courier-bot: Tracking update (CN-553344): Status: DELIVERED to Building C, 2026-07-14 17:03. Destination label: BUILDING C - RECEPTION. Sender requested hold-for-pickup. Pickup code: HLD-992.

ana (People Ops): Plan: 1) Request hold until 09:30 tomorrow (preferred). 2) If not possible, redirect to Building A reception (15m walk) OR 3) dispatch replacement overnight (cost ~ $95). Which should I authorise now?

lee (new hire): I can pick up at Building C at 09:00 if reception holds. I'll bring passport.

marco (Facilities): I'll add Lee to the authorized pickup list and notify security. Reception will ask for government ID + pickup code HLD-992. I'll confirm in this thread when added.

it-oncall: FYI checklist for Day 1 without hardware: - Zoom link + calendar event - Slack invite sent - Temporary SSO token (expires 24h) - Remote desktop image: rwinf-day1-lite

ana (People Ops): Courier contacted  hold requested and confirmed. Reception will log release and snap a photo. If reception reports no-show by 10:00 we'll ship replacement.

courier-bot: Courier confirms hold request accepted. Note: Package will be held 24h only.

marco (Facilities): Lee added to pickup list under code LE-PICKUP-1845. Reception confirmed they'll release to ID + pickup code.

lee (new hire): Thanks all, arriving 09:00 with passport and phone +1 650-555-0147. Appreciate the fast responses. :)

marco (Facilities): Pickup complete  reception released package to Lee at 09:08, recorded ID matching passport. Photo of handoff uploaded to portal.

ana (People Ops): Closing the loop  welcome Lee! Sam (IT) will follow up on laptop enrollment if any setup remains.

it-oncall: Sent onboarding checklist DM and temporary SSO. Ping here if any access issues.
